messages.author: 1ebcca668c473f8c
messages.subject: Problem Installing RHIPE on Fedora 13
parts:
When trying to install RHIPE on Fedora 13, I get the following error:
http://pastebin.com/RqSz1fT6

I installed Google's Protocol Buffers (yum install protobuf*), but for
some reason I get asked during the RHIPE installation to update the
Protocol Buffer headers (whatever that means).

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Problem Installing RHIPE on Fedora 13
parts:
What version of protobuf was installed? RHIPE uses protobuffers verson 2.3.0
Try this
> protoc --version
libprotoc 2.3.0

You'll probably need to compile from source or use some other repo.

Regards
Joy

messages.subject: Re: Problem Installing RHIPE on Fedora 13

I compiled protobuf 2.3.0 from source, and now everything works. I
also had to set the environment variable PKG_CONFIG_PATH to /usr/local/
lib/pkgconfig before installing RHIPE.
